decision.scopeOfReject: This REJECT is of g09-leftover-join.v4 as a current G09 execution-remainder remeasurement. It is not a rejection of the leftover partition the artifact reports: the seven obligations, the single leftover-design member OBL-FX-AUTHORING, the fourteen FX classes, the separate R-10/R-6 race set, and the untouched eight-member DR-105 remainder all survive scrutiny and match frozen v3 exactly. decision.summaryForCoordinator: REJECT at 2 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX. The subject is unmoved at 04fbd074… mode 0444, and all 36 cited digests recompute byte-exactly, including file 08 at f909ddff… and HEAD at bd67a3b. Live required-now is 28 and the DR-G09 token is OPEN, both matching the subject. The obligation set and the leftoverDesign map are identical to frozen v3, so nothing was smuggled into or out of the leftover partition, and v3 itself is unmoved and correctly declined as a current remeasurement. Twenty-two of twenty-five attacks are refuted, including every SATISFIED, envelope-invention, fixture-byte, row-addition, required-now-mutation, R-10/R-6 folding, self-version, D-167-placeholder, and implementation-authorization attack. Two blockers stand, both in the same citation. First, the subject asserts permission-leftover-join.v7 as the live DR-105 ROW leftover-join that 'still measures' the DR-105 leftovers; v7 was measured at HEAD 5d5d778 and required-now 26, and ADOPTED D-171 of 2026-08-20 records v9 (71c0b80b…, measured at required-now 28) as the DR-105 leftover remeasurement while stating in terms 'v7/v8 stay frozen; do not record them.' An artifact whose declared purpose is to remeasure after D-167/D-169/D-188 has re-imported a superseded predecessor as current, which is the enumerated required-now-26-as-live attack reached through the citation layer. Second, the subject states 'Codex not reviewed' for v7, while a completed 0444 Codex review of exactly the cited v7 digest, dated 2026-08-20 and therefore available before the subject was authored, returns REJECT at 1 SHOULD-FIX (PLJ-V7-SF1), whose substance is that v7 lacks live D-169/D-170 remeasurement — the same staleness class this subject exists to cure. Both defects are repairable as citation text: re-cite v9 with its dual ACCEPT 0/0 recorded by D-171, describe v7 as a frozen do-not-record predecessor with its true Codex standing, and restate the four dependent sentences. Because v7, v8, and v9 agree exactly on OBL-R10-R6-INPUT-CORPUS false and on the eight-member DR-105 leftover list, no obligation value in this artifact changes under repair and parity with frozen v3 is preserved. DR-G09 stays OPEN, required-now stays 28, DR-105 is not SATISFIED, OBL-FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design, and nothing is sealed, recorded, or authorized by this verdict.
